title: Domain combat events plus first generic Projectile presentation contract
objective: Close the missing CombatEvent seam from the skill resolver and prove that a generic Projectile presentation plan consumes immutable resolved combat facts without owning or mutating damage/resource truth.
hypothesis: If SkillCastResolution emits immutable SkillCast/Damage/TargetDefeated facts and a pure-C# Projectile planner consumes only those facts plus SkillDefinition presentation metadata, then Unity/VFX can later attach to that plan without gaining authority over combat mechanics.
claim_boundary: No UnityEngine dependency, prefab playback, timing values, camera, sound, VFX fidelity, Unity compile/runtime or original PAL3 visual fidelity is claimed by this experiment.

attempts.description: Emit immutable combat facts from the already-resolved single-target skill result; build a timing-free generic Projectile cue plan and verify that planning cannot mutate encounter HP/MP.

next_recommended_experiment: If verified, add the thinnest Unity-facing adapter that consumes SkillPresentationPlan when Unity activation becomes available, or continue domain targeting work without changing presentation authority.
